misc.text: #ONEPIECE1191 Hajrudin is now entrusting Elbaph to Loki, and something happens that Harald had always wished for: Loki and Hajrudin ruling Elbaph together. I think that, after the chaos, both of them will ascend the throne together and lead Elbaph.

misc.text: [#ONEPIECE1191] FOUND THE 4 HORNS PARALLEL!! Oda paralleling imu new four horn transformation to “The Four Horns Of Zechariah 1:18-21!!! It represents full on global powers, Oppression. The Horns also said to represent the ambient of strength, Military & might!!!

misc.text: #ONEPIECE1191 It wasn't just the Rocks Pirates who became significantly stronger after God Valley. Roger and his crew also grew stronger. The fact that Imu praises Gaban here serves to build genuine hype for the Pirate King. It wasn't for nothing that Kaido hyped Roger so much.
